_doc: Every box on this catalogue is set here, not auto-detected: the stock detector (paper -> ink mask -> rows/columns) matched the record count on only 11 of 114 pages because the watches sit on light-cyan panels and binding shade bridges columns. Boxes come from a caption-bullet-anchored variant (.pilot/1975-1975-seiko-v22/tools/dots.py + boxes.py: blue ● before each ref -> photo above it), plus hand-set boxes (.pilot/1975-1975-seiko-v22/manual.json) for the photo spreads p1-8, the pocket-watch pages p69-70 and the fancy/pendant/pocket/stopwatch pages p106-113. Oct 2026: every box checked on the per-page check sheets.
